title: outbuf always allocates 1MB+512B regardless of operation
description: In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c, outbuf_ensure(): currently always allocates CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_MAX (1MB+512B). For a SHA-256 hash the output is 32 bytes; for AES-GCM the output matches input size. Fix: pass the expected output size to outbuf_ensure, or size it lazily based on op type. For HASH op: size = digest constant (32-64 bytes). For symmetric/AEAD: size = bytes_written (known after write completes). The 1MB allocation should only happen for large payload ops. Minimum: cap at actual needed size per operation rather than always worst-case.
